# semaphore_ex_project_integration_matcher (Data Source)

Manage or read a condition that an incoming integration request must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_project_integration_matcher" "branch" {
  project_id     = 1
  integration_id = 2
  id             = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Matcher ID assigned by Semaphore EX. Value must be at least 1.
- `integration_id` (Number) Integration containing the matcher. Value must be at least 1.
- `project_id` (Number) Project containing the integration. Value must be at least 1.

### Read-Only

- `body_data_type` (String) Body interpretation for body matchers.
- `key` (String) Header name or JSON field path to match.
- `match_type` (String) Request component to inspect: header or body.
- `method` (String) Comparison operator.
- `name` (String) Matcher name.
- `value` (String) Expected value.
